message:
feat(ka-pc r1, WIP): the managed standby viewer of a kept PC, and the shell that keeps up to three

KA ③, Codex O1 (codex_ka_pc_design_r1.md), proposal_ka_pc_r2.md. Built (Release, 0 warnings in these
files) and the pure units pass; the managed flow has NOT been run yet (GPU slot held) -- WIP.

Viewer:
- run_session: one session on a context of its own; a process can run another after it (window class
  re-registration tolerated, the window procedure's statics and the toolbar reset per session).
- --managed-standby (viewer_managed_standby.cpp): one PC's StandbyLease (StandbyRunner, the directory
  capability through its own socket, a per-key generation store named by the key's full SHA-256),
  no window/decoder/MF/D3D until Activate; an activation is one session on the lease's duplicated
  socket (open_media_socket takes it, connect_media_socket runs the lease handshake instead of Hello),
  no retry dialog, no shutdown() on the shared socket; after the threads joined: SessionOver (or
  Abandon when the socket was never taken); the window never outlives the session. No automatic
  re-activation (Codex 5). PickerReady / Presented milestones.
- managed_viewer_ipc.hpp: framed messages over two inherited anonymous pipes, bounded queues, its own
  reader/writer threads, bounded Close; every message stamped key + incarnation + owner epoch.

Shell:
- client_managed_viewers.hpp: suspended -> own job (KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE) -> resume; a child that cannot
  be put in its job never runs. Only the child's pipe ends are inherited. Ending is Release/Shutdown,
  then a bounded wait and TerminateJobObject on a reaper thread.
- client_recent_hosts.hpp: origin + account + hostId, ordered by a sequence number, escaped fields,
  three per account, wide paths, atomic replace.
- client_shell_main.cpp: two switches (automatic preparation at sign-in OFF; keep on list return ON);
  a connected directory session the user closed goes to standby (first conversion); a ready kept PC
  is activated on tap, a preparing one says so; at most three (LRU of those not in use); owner epoch
  moved first, then end_owner_children (managed + the shell's ordinary viewers: cancel, then
  terminate after 3 s off the UI thread); token renewals reach the viewers (version).
- shell.html: per-card busy; the kept state only from the viewers' reports.

Tests: ka_pc_units_test (IPC frames/channel, recent store incl. a non-ASCII folder), ka_pc_managed_e2e
(not run yet), GNLinkViewerKaTest (+ reentry probe).
